_comment: Ledger: blocks, transactions, rules and state of every era (module ledger). Its reference is cardano-ledger. docs/design/correspondence-map.md says what an entry holds; scripts/check_correspondence.py checks it.

class ledger.era.conway.ConwayPParams.note: THKD carries the groups as the singleton types of DRepGroup's and StakePoolGroup's cases

def ledger.byron.ByronLedger.applyTx.note: the outputs a transaction creates are keyed by the hash of its bytes as received; the reference's txId is serializeCborHash of the transaction encoded again. The rule's other checks are not mapped here: the counterpart named is where the difference is

def ledger.era.conway.ConwayPParams.modi.note: the union of ppGroup over the record's THKD fields, written out field by field where the reference's default traverses the record's Generic representation

object ledger.era.ConwayEraPParamsInstan.note: Conway's four instances in one object, given in each class's companion; the instances' upgradePParamsHKD, downgradePParamsHKD, emptyUpgradePParamsUpdate and eraPParams are not here yet, nor the update's Plutus data (#85), and the members the reference confines to a range of eras are classes of their own

trait ledger.era.AlonzoEraPParams.note: hkdCoinsPerUTxOWordL, Alonzo's alone, is a class of its own with Alonzo's record

trait ledger.era.EraPParams.note: the members the reference confines to a range of eras (hkdDL, hkdExtraEntropyL, hkdProtocolVersionL, ppuProtocolVersionL, hkdMinUTxOValueCompactL) are classes of their own with their eras' records; upgradePParamsHKD, downgradePParamsHKD, emptyUpgradePParamsUpdate and eraPParams are not here yet (#85)

type ledger.era.CostModels.note: the valid models (known languages) and the unknown ones (unknown tags) in one map by tag, a tag being in only one of the two; the reference's pair of maps orders differently, and a known language's evaluation context is the cost-model decoder's to check

type ledger.era.ExUnits.note: over the node's units, holding only those with no negative component, as Natural's are

type ledger.era.HKDNoUpdate.note: a match type on F applied to a probe: Identity, StrictMaybe (Scala's Option, Maybe too) and any other constructor; at Some, below Option, it does not reduce, so a record over Some does not compile where the reference gives Some a

val ledger.era.ExUnits.zero.note: the value emptyConwayPParams gives the field

val ledger.era.OrdExUnits.zero.note: the value emptyConwayPParams gives the field

val ledger.era.Prices.zero.note: the value emptyConwayPParams gives the field

glue.reason: the state layout of each reference build Scarab can follow, and the defect of a build whose layout is not implemented yet, which the node's setup refuses before any rule runs (#1002, stage 0); the reference is one build and has no counterpart

the conversions between the parameters the node keeps (the flat `ProtocolParams`, the decoded `ConwayParamUpdate` and the flat voting thresholds) and the era's record; the reference keeps the record itself and has no counterpart (#85)
companion objects that only hold an era's instances, constructors or the Scala `Ordering` of a type whose order the reference derives

Scala machinery with no counterpart: the probe and invariant wrapper that let a match type tell `Identity` from `StrictMaybe`, the names of the parameter groups' singleton types, constants checked when compiled, accessors of opaque types, and the checked constructors' typed refusals
Scala names for `Identity` (base's `Data.Functor.Identity`) and `StrictMaybe` (strict-containers' `Data.Maybe.Strict`), which are outside cardano-ledger; Scala's `Option` is strict
